description.en: Enigma2 receivers through OpenWebif: power, volume, channels, programme guide, TV messages.

description.en: Enigma2 receivers (VU+, Dreambox, Zgemma, Octagon, GigaBlue…) with the OpenWebif plugin, installed on most images. Up to three receivers. Not affiliated with any receiver manufacturer.

description.de: Enigma2-Receiver (VU+, Dreambox, Zgemma, Octagon, GigaBlue…) mit dem OpenWebif-Plugin, das die meisten Images mitbringen. Bis zu drei Receiver. Mit keinem Hersteller verbunden.
description.es: Receptores Enigma2 (VU+, Dreambox, Zgemma, Octagon, GigaBlue…) con el plugin OpenWebif, presente en la mayoría de imágenes. Hasta tres receptores. Sin relación con ningún fabricante.
